description: This Java source file defines the PolicyCommandFactory class, which creates command objects (specifically SudoRetrievePolicy) to interact with the Policies service. It includes methods to generate commands with appropriate headers and correlation IDs, utilizing external classes and utilities related to policies, headers, logging, and UUID generation.

classes.name: PolicyCommandFactory
classes.description: A utility class responsible for creating commands to access and retrieve policies, specifically generating SudoRetrievePolicy commands with optional cache lookup context and appropriate headers.

methods.name: sudoRetrievePolicy
methods.description: Creates a SudoRetrievePolicy command using a provided EntityId and optional cache lookup context, converting the EntityId to a PolicyId.

methods.name: sudoRetrievePolicy
methods.description: Creates a SudoRetrievePolicy command directly from a PolicyId and optional cache lookup context, setting headers and correlation IDs accordingly.

methods.name: getCorrelationId
methods.description: Generates or retrieves a correlation ID for tracing, using UUID if none exists, and logging the event.
